note: City of Kulm campground run by the park board, beside the municipal pool and park; campers swim free when the pool is open. Back-in sites with water, sewer and electric. Part of the campground is taken by seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: City page names the campground, the park board and the reservation number (701-269-0014) but posts no rate, season, site count or hookups. Camper report 2021: ~20 level back-in sites, water/sewer, 30/50 A, free pool. No dated rate anywhere. Booking written (reserve by phone). Long-stay mix flagged; not a drop on what is readable.
flags: LONG-STAY (local, mixed): Google review (7 years ago): 'This is a residential trailer park with no overnighter facilities. Use of the adjacent pool is included'; but a 2021 Dyrt camper stayed overnight at site 7 ('Convenient campground on the edge of the small town ... about 20 back in sites') and the newest Google review (edited ~3 months ago) says 'Small but has all you need'. Imagery: a row of ~8 back-in pads east of the pool lot (~46.2982,-98.9437) mostly empty, and north of the entrance road a block of ~10 trailers with sheds and parked vehicles (~46.2988,-98.9442) that reads as seasonal/long-term. Nightly share roughly 40-50%. Google 3.6 / 8 (fewer than 25 reviews). Reviewer call; not proposed as a drop.
